title: The village market
summary: A story that shows how place value helps people compare totals at the market.

chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content: At the market, one vendor kept track of baskets in rows. The row on the left counted hundreds, while the row on the right counted ones.

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content: When the same number moved to a different row, its value changed, which reminded the vendor that place matters.

moral: Place value tells us how much a digit is worth, not just what symbol it is.

title: The changing box
summary: A story that turns a variable into a tool for describing change.

chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content: A teacher used a box to hold a secret number and wrote the letter $x$ on it so the class could talk about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content: When the box gained 5 more items, the class could describe the new amount with $x + 5$.

moral: Variables let us describe unknown or changing quantities clearly.

title: The shared pizza
summary: A story about sharing a pizza equally and describing parts of a whole.

chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content: Three friends shared a pizza cut into eight equal slices, and each person wanted to know what fraction they received.

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content: The slices were counted as parts of the whole, which made the fraction $ rac{3}{8}$ easy to explain.

moral: Fractions describe how much of a whole you have.
